result.keyword: What's the best payroll software for a small business?
result.markdown:
The best payroll software for a small business depends mainly on where your employees are based, how many people you pay, and whether you want payroll to handle tax calculations and submissions automatically.

**My recommendation is to choose a full-service payroll platform** rather than software that simply calculates wages. It can save considerable time and reduce payroll errors.

## Best payroll software for a UK small business

Assuming you're operating in the UK, these are the options I'd shortlist for 2026.

![Sage Payroll](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/YilOgYs9ZP1wfwRzJkFxhA_BlX-p_5FLJTmLkaXii1Zq8iZVEoUFx_wBfKoiVfr0ATGd3JsvVUZhJ3dfKZOkGYm_SBzjjNOitZcJhhfq0Ikj-wTCq4Ucb9ThPMpreJ_oVOHjuM4KTvvryzuP8dhTVsVMgw7AVYaGKaHDYZzKiFaOrf3CUXwlR8gKxA64DoWs?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Sage Payroll**

(Best overall)

- Good standalone payroll solution.
- PAYE, National Insurance and HMRC RTI submissions.
- Workplace pension support.
- Indicative price: £12/month for up to five employees.

[Sage website](https://www.sage.com/en-gb/)

---

![Small business, big stress – and finding the right balance for success](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/js_DP_ZcJt2b0HYevLiH8RyWaqBcysH-7umi2-OpUv1L_c7R6GqF2ePsaUUNhFEx0xoCJM9UhE2ygbfJvKTZATLo4fmY2I8PpXkEP4z5gNTNS9QARFCTPWNcGDYwVCjusvLzfwG5BpY7OHDvJf-Gvvkz7eUnU1rkY8PEcDFGKBEcxvEb1v6GA_F2cLDI9Uk_?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Xero Payroll**

(Best for existing Xero users)

- Payroll integrated with accounting.
- Employee payslips and pension management.
- Useful financial reporting.
- Payroll included in certain plans.

[Xero website](https://www.xero.com/uk/)

---

![BrightPay Standard + Connect to BrightPay Cloud FAQs](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/w4enxIyDycO7AUK2q9MSigbCrvpztFs7Z_H6w-w2lUCrViF19Xl4mmIDmq49uY9OqMEZyacb1cfZ96kB1itVQG4Um52YB5FfIcdxh61NUZmjo-ZiQQw-o3a64YCd83vlmMVrUh7TPEkE6dshtPXZgYIC-gPHTX5mwqy58KHGJgCW85IZxwm6G0figtCehl5s?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. BrightPay**

(Best dedicated payroll)

- Strong payroll processing features.
- Pension auto-enrolment.
- Employee self-service.
- Particularly useful for payroll-focused businesses.

[BrightPay website](https://www.brightpay.co.uk/)

---

![QuickBooks Payroll Workshop Coming up at Landmark - Landmark CPAs](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/EpjoKgv3qp1QFtZSwa4jOSAGoy_bpW7Sg9OVIiK8-oa8UMuOdZRCQiQ9wIV6A0EP90E_oKZqlgba5b3V-cBIKwbDpfEpoiDXWBpJxyQbp0PrvFWqMD5tYDybAbqob6mWzYEtZyXdxwg9oLN481huockY4Xh7GxIqIqUTHjoFCNUvsU8P9qXqQ0Z3Uur0cFsF?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. QuickBooks Payroll**

(Best for accounting integration)

- Payroll connected to bookkeeping.
- HMRC submissions.
- Employee payment and payroll records.
- Good if you already use QuickBooks.

[QuickBooks website](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/uk/)

---

![Employment Hero Logo & Brand Assets (SVG, PNG and vector) - Brandfetch](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/Z6qVhSSYF5CYFaR38tVZ9vpu364SrI1qcU-LhtFo5MrKvM2IIECP5NGDLvCA9qSi3OHN3nIGoWj3sOAoSGJ3TbpMzqye4Jq3Q2-1Ae4X05g3VDo154uJn7RkzUUAY3Xfi51rzm16rZPnUZ2NnrKj1KHaQU4ePGT94fhowd8mNNeyff58VJ3Le5GJh2e89NE4?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Employment Hero**

(Best for HR and payroll together)

- Payroll and employee management.
- HR documentation and onboarding.
- Useful as your workforce grows.

[Employment Hero website](https://employmenthero.com/uk/)

Pricing is indicative and can change. ## My recommendation

I'd narrow it down as follows\:

| Your situation | My choice |
|--------|--------|
| Small business, 1–5 employees | Sage |
| Already using Xero | Xero Payroll |
| Payroll is your main requirement | BrightPay |
| Already using QuickBooks | QuickBooks |
| Growing team needing HR too | Employment Hero |


One important point: check that your chosen software is recognised by HMRC for PAYE reporting. You can check the official list [here](https://www.gov.uk/guidance/find-payroll-software-that-is-recognised-by-hmrc)\. search_results.description: RUN Powered by ADP is a payroll and HR platform aimed at businesses with fewer than 50 employees. Its four plans range from Essential Payroll, covering payroll, taxes, and compliance, to HR Pro, which adds services such as applicant tracking, learning management, and legal assistance. Pricing is quote-based. The platform offers automated payroll, tax filing, employee self-service, onboarding, reporting, mobile access, reminders, and AI-powered error flagging. Its intuitive interface and clear workflows make it accessible to small businesses without dedicated HR expertise. Support includes 24/7 payroll phone assistance, weekday live chat, and additional HR support on higher tiers, though users report that payroll help can sometimes be slow. Key drawbacks include limited analytics, customization, API access, and integrations, as well as extra costs for add-ons such as time tracking, retirement, workers’ compensation, and health insurance. Overall, RUN is a strong choice for small businesses seeking straightforward payroll and core HR tools, but growing organizations with more complex needs may prefer a more flexible platform.
